note: OpenCode V2 resolves its provider and model catalog from models.dev (opencode.ai/v2/docs/providers). This file pins the model ids a copyable example may cite. `fetchedAt` and `catalogSha256` record the catalog snapshot taken when the ids were pinned (provenance only; NOT recomputed or verified by any script, and the live catalog changes over time). Verify the ids against the live catalog with `bun web/site/verify-example-models.mjs` (network lane).
